queue_policy.promotion_condition: RSH-001 must be explicitly accepted and merged into main before RSH-002 becomes eligible.

stages.name: Control and governance
stages.gate: A single canonical state, queue and governance model exists.

stages.name: Toolchain and CI
stages.gate: A clean clone passes one reproducible required CI command.

stages.name: Scope, licensing and assets
stages.gate: Version 1 scope and every shipped asset's legal status are explicit.

stages.name: Architecture decomposition
stages.gate: Core responsibilities are separated and resource ownership is explicit.

stages.name: Data integrity and production security
stages.gate: Save data is recoverable and production contains no debug or secret exposure.

stages.name: Ayalon vertical slice
stages.gate: Ayalon is owner-approved, golden-locked and dependency-frozen.

stages.name: Performance and reliability
stages.gate: Performance, leak, recovery, soak and compatibility targets pass.

stages.name: UX, accessibility and mobile
stages.gate: Keyboard, touch and gamepad flows pass UX, accessibility and privacy gates.

stages.name: Seven additional Version 1 tracks
stages.gate: Eight of eight MVP tracks are driveable, golden-approved and frozen.

stages.name: Release
stages.gate: All 13 release gates pass and v1.0.0 has rollback proof.
